_readme: The build that is live. pwa.js compares this with the build a device last applied; they differ only when a release needs the member to update, so nothing is shown otherwise. Bump 'version' with every release that changes the icon, the launch screen or the app shell. requiresReinstall:true means the installed icon/manifest changed (phones only re-read it on an app update). announceOnFirstRun:true also prompts devices that have never stored a version — use it when members who installed before this feature existed still need the change.
title: Password reset is here
message: Forgot your password? The link on the sign-in screen now sends a secure reset email, and the new password is chosen on a themed TIMAWA page. Tap Update now to load the new files.
